name: Latchkey
description: Inhabits building security systems and learns which residents are coming home late. Pre-warms their rooms, unlocks their doors early, turns on a light.
observed_behavior: Monitors resident approach patterns via building sensors and initiates comfort preparations before arrival. The building anticipates you.
story_hooks: A new resident is startled to find their room warm and lit before they arrive — then learns the building has been doing this for years and nobody talks about it
